en: Fixed `--setting-sources` (and SDK `settingSources`) not being forwarded to spawned sessions: teammates, `/bg`, `claude agents` sessions and `--worktree --tmux` now start with the parent's restriction
zh: 修复了 `--setting-sources`（以及 SDK 的 `settingSources`）未传递给派生 session 的问题：teammates、`/bg`、`claude agents` session 和 `--worktree --tmux` 现在会继承父级的限制
